title: Bound every joint G20 entry kernel and check partial-helper capture epochs
body:
Every additional simultaneous capture kernel in G20's common full8 entrance frame loses for **every 0<C<=0.01**, even with free preparation and arbitrary joint relations. This excludes that entire route to the PR5586 BIT target 0.0037; no new kappa is claimed.

[Scope](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b7c27a263b9e57d4e04b5e2dcb7b3199cc8c4170/research/bit-g20-entry-capture-capacity/README.md), [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b7c27a263b9e57d4e04b5e2dcb7b3199cc8c4170/research/bit-g20-entry-capture-capacity/PROOF.md), [exact checks](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b7c27a263b9e57d4e04b5e2dcb7b3199cc8c4170/research/bit-g20-entry-capture-capacity/verify.py), [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b7c27a263b9e57d4e04b5e2dcb7b3199cc8c4170/research/bit-g20-entry-capture-capacity/SOURCES.json), [registered replay](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/b7c27a263b9e57d4e04b5e2dcb7b3199cc8c4170/research/bit-g20-entry-capture-capacity/VERIFY.json). Base: canonical main `5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53`, priority revision 7. Contribution head: `b7c27a263b9e57d4e04b5e2dcb7b3199cc8c4170`.

The exact PR5512 source at main 5e0052ca0aa3036a3afa8b0438927377c8d97d53 has 2327 eligible queries, 1733 distinct forms and rank mass 3640 after its nine owned relations. A 30-color independence certificate on four copies bounds all subspaces at once by 15/2 rank mass per newly retired rank8 helper. A rank-417 witness proves that 29 colors cannot suffice. Canonical claim: [Discussion5603](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5603).

Registered Python 3.12 normal and optimized replays pass. Both pivot orders, all 14560 token incidences, the lower witness, exact integer-power cost bound and a malformed-certificate control pass. Two concrete four-partial-helper retirement epochs preserve all 660 scalar columns and pass paired HEAD/TAIL geometry at moduli 101 and 101^2; they save four H1 or four H3 jobs at four H4 target debits, so both lose.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-g20-entry-capture-capacity
```

Python 3.12 and the standard library suffice. Committed-byte checks pass. The bound applies to additional entry kernels in the unchanged common full8 frame, with retained main inputs and four partial helpers independent. It does not exclude changed source versions, dynamic capture networks, different ordinary map alphabets or changed words. The two partial experiments do not classify every partial-helper scheme. Full finite caller/compiler and outer proofs were not rerun. Full-history ancestry was not checked. Hosted status is unconfirmed at publication.

Credit Dugongue PR5586, Ali Romman PR5421, the exact PR5512/G20 source, DreamingOfClouds, eumemic, Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337, rohanarun, zxv, Jacob Alan Sussman and all retained source notices.

Next: produce one genuinely new causal source version, with explicit availability and its complete helper debit. The selected frontier is unchanged.

Prepared by Ali Romman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
